theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  have hl := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  have hl' := InitStatesLength Hinit
  have Hdisj : List.Disjoint ks ks' := by
    intro k hk hk'
    have h1 := UpdateStatesDefined Hup k hk
    have h2 := InitStatesNotDefined Hinit k hk'
    simp_all
  have Hdef : isDefined (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks :=
    updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' Hup) (ves := ks'.zip vs')
  have Hcomm : updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs = σ'' := by
    rw [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup]
    exact updatedStatesComm (kvs := ks'.zip vs') (kvs' := ks.zip vs)
      (by rw [List.unzip_zip hl', List.unzip_zip hl]; exact Hdisj.symm)
  exact ⟨updatedStates σ ks' vs', rfl,
    updatedStatesInit hl'
      (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup)
      (InitStatesNodup Hinit),
    Hcomm ▸ updatedStatesUpdate hl Hdef⟩
